name: zrndr_lens_flare_draw_queued_samples_scaled16_clipped_framebuffer
description: zRndr::LensFlare_DrawQueuedSamplesScaled16_ClippedFramebuffer draws each queued software lens-flare sample at the supplied scale/y-offset, then clears the sample queue and overlay blend flag.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL and assembly at 0x49a8c0 show a fastcall yOffsetPixels plus stack screenScale wrapper that iterates g_zRndr_LensFlareSampleQueue while the signed queue count remains positive, calls zRndr::LensFlare_DrawQueuedSample16_ClippedFramebuffer for each 0x14-byte sample, then stores zero to g_zRndr_LensFlareSampleQueueCount and gRndr_OverlayBlendEnabled.

The native queue smoke verifies two queued samples are drawn through the per-sample helper with y-offset projection, the queue count is cleared, the overlay flag is cleared, and the zero-count path still clears the overlay flag without drawing.
